description: This file defines a configuration resolver class for device profiles table in an Angular application, including setup for columns, actions, and data handling related to device profiles.

classes.name: DeviceProfilesTableConfigResolver
classes.description: Angular service class that provides configuration for device profiles table, including columns, actions, and data operations.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Returns the configured EntityTableConfig for device profiles.

methods.name: configureAddActions
methods.description: Sets up the add and import actions for the device profiles table.

methods.name: addDeviceProfile
methods.description: Opens a dialog to create a new device profile and refreshes data upon completion.

methods.name: setDefaultDeviceProfile
methods.description: Sets a device profile as default after user confirmation.

methods.name: openDeviceProfile
methods.description: Navigates to the detailed view of a specific device profile.

methods.name: importDeviceProfile
methods.description: Imports a device profile via the import service and refreshes data.

methods.name: onDeviceProfileAction
methods.description: Handles actions triggered on device profile entries such as open, setDefault, and export.
